description: MapBiomas Bolivia is a multi-institution network of universities, organisations and technology companies that produces maps and data on the transformation of Bolivian territory from satellite images, processed in the cloud with machine learning algorithms in Google Earth Engine. Its products are an annual land cover and land use series since 1985 that separates natural formations from human-used areas (Collection 3 was released on 31 July 2025), a surface water series with annual and monthly maps since 1985, a burned area series with annual and monthly maps since 1995, and MapBiomas Alerta, which reviews, validates and refines deforestation alerts. The MapBiomas platform, renewed in 2025 and shared by the 17 countries of the network, lets users cross themes such as forest, agriculture, grassland, mining, fire scars and surface water with territories and 3D maps, and the download section gives GeoTIFF maps, Google Earth Engine assets, legend codes, statistics and method documents (ATBD). The data is public, open and free with attribution under the CC BY 4.0 licence. Caveats: the maps are classifications with their own accuracy per collection. Coverage is Bolivia. It supports hazard exposure analysis for wildfire, flood and drought around roads, pipelines and settlements, and nature-based solution planning; the related record is ESA WorldCover.
